applicability: Review reads started by successive selections, refreshes or page requests on one mounted surface.
conditions: Every read takes the next sequence number; only the newest may write displayed read/frame/retained state.
The unshown reuse exception is only an unpaged whole-task request with no refresh identity and an admitted reviewed answer, keyed by the same task/history/question identity.
A known incompatible code-tree/snapshot generation rejects unshown reuse; when no generation is known the answer establishes it and a later different generation clears the stores.
exclusions: Cancelling the superseded network request; it is ignored, not aborted (O-R1-3).
Superseded selected subjects, paged continuations, refresh answers, failures and refusals never use the unshown whole-task reuse exception.
statement: Rapid selected-subject reads A→B→C settle on C: superseded selected-subject answers neither display nor enter the cache, so returning to B asks again; an admitted superseded whole-task answer may be kept unshown for its compatible comparison generation without moving the displayed generation or writing the panes.
